subject: Re: Accelerator onboarding — stacking free credits with pilot discount
messages:
From: Sylvia Chen <sylvia@lumenlabs.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator onboarding — credits stacking question

Hi Tessa,

Quick question as we're finalizing our accelerator package: your onboarding coordinator mentioned a 6-month free credits pool for seed-stage partners. Our partners also qualify for a 25% pilot discount that your team sometimes applies to demo accounts. Can those two offers be combined for the same entity?

Our board review is next week and we want to confirm whether we can include a combined consumption figure in the pro forma. If stacking is allowed, any limits (cap per org, expiration) we should note?

Also, if it helps to move faster, we're open to a short-term sweetener (e.g., extra credits for demo day) in exchange for a signed addendum before May 5.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

– Sylvia
Director, Lumen Labs Accelerator

Attachments: accelerator-deck-v3.pdf (referenced)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Chen <sylvia@lumenlabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator onboarding — credits stacking question

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the note and congrats on the cohort planning. Short answer: yes, we can structure a stacking path but with a controlled addendum. High-level terms I can confirm now:

- Free onboarding credits (the standard accelerator pool) can be combined with a pilot discount on a per-entity basis, provided the customer is a cohort participant and both offers are referenced in a signed seat/deal addendum.
- Stacking window: credits and discount must be consumed within a 90-day window from activation by the customer (we can shorten to 60 days on request).
- Cap: we typically cap combined promotional value at $50k USD per entity unless we escalate to commercial for larger exceptions. For demo-day sweeteners we can offer a one-time top-up (examples below).

If you sign the addendum before May 5 we can include a one-time demo top-up equal to 30k token credits (not transferrable) and extend the consumption window to 120 days. We'll need legal to approve the clause language and billing to confirm invoicing flow so usage is visible in your finance reports.

I've attached a short mutual action plan that sketches the steps and timelines (Lumen-MAP-v1.pdf). If that looks good I'll loop in Laura (billing/finance) and Marissa (partner ops) to confirm accounting and any tax/receipt details.

Next steps I propose:
- You review the attached MAP and confirm whether you want the demo top-up.
- If yes, confirm the list of up to 10 cohort companies that will be eligible for stacking.
- Redwood legal will prepare an addendum; target sign-before date May 5 to secure the top-up.

Best,
Tessa
Head of Startup Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Lumen-MAP-v1.pdf
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Accelerator onboarding — credits stacking question

Team — forwarding Sylvia's ask and my proposed commercial path. Key points to approve:

1) Demo top-up: one-time 30k token credit per cohort (company pool) if signed by May 5. Will be listed as a promotional credit line in HubSpot.
2) Cap: promotional stacking capped at $50k per entity for standard approval. Anything above should escalate to Ben for exec approval.
3) Window: default 90-day consumption; extend to 120 days for cohorts that sign by May 5.
4) Accounting: need to ensure credits show as promotional (not revenue) and we capture usage for potential overage billing after expiration.

Laura — can you confirm the accounting/tax treatment and whether we need an invoice addendum? Marissa — any ops blockers for applying these credits in bulk to cohort accounts?

Quoted message below.

Tessa
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sylvia Chen <sylvia@lumenlabs.com>, Evan Brooks <legal@lumenlabs.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator onboarding — credits stacking question (addendum draft attached)

Hi Sylvia — thanks for the clear ask and hi Evan.

We can move forward with the proposal Tessa outlined with two operational/legal clarifications from our side:

1) Promotional accounting: the demo top-up and accelerator credits will be recorded as contra-revenue/promotional credits on Redwood's books. We will surface usage in your portal and provide a single CSV export per cohort for your billing team on request.

2) Legal redline: our counsel proposes a short addendum that (a) specifies the stacking cap at $50k per entity unless otherwise approved in writing; (b) states that promotional credits expire at the end of the consumption window and are forfeited (no rollover); and (c) requires cohorts to accept standard Acceptable Use terms (we can't apply stacking to entities that are on enterprise private deployments without a separate security review).

I've attached a draft addendum (credit-addendum-draft.docx) with the proposed language. Evan — please review and let us know your edits. If you can approve commercial redlines by EOD Thursday we'll aim to route a DocuSign for signature so the cohort list and the demo top-up can be activated before May 5.

If you prefer, we can limit the demo top-up to five named companies instead of ten — that will make ledgering slightly simpler.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Revenue Operations (Finance)
Redwood Inference

Attachment: credit-addendum-draft.docx
